exposure: Fresh source-informed target-known problems frozen after reading the five directly supplied scientific notes and before curation. Not held out or unassisted agent evaluation. Baseline is the reviewed PR251 projection tree,which must be verified identical at the actual merge before use as next intake base. No ranking/model/ontology or query-specific alias tuning.

cases.query: Can I determine matched hidden-target power by collecting only the return through the reciprocal mode I launched,instead of measuring all outgoing modes? What extra receiver information and target loads would I need?

My hidden-target signal is nearly zero and the feedback pole is not identifiable. Can three known passive load settings and local phase-stepped powers still give a uniformly stable target-power estimate without dividing by an estimated pole?

A weak reflected target sits on a bright background. Receiver gain,offset and quadrature leakage stay common across three load states,but are uncertain. Must I pay the full background as an absolute calibration floor,or can I derive a certified relative interval?

I can query noisy quadratic powers of an unknown positive rank-one matrix,possibly zero. How can I reconstruct it in operator norm with a linear number of queries and a bound that does not assume a strong pivot in advance?
unavailable: an informative pivot supplied in advance

cases.query: If I measure the complete complex reflection at a matched target load and one known nonzero load for every launched vector,is absolute target power now identifiable? I need a passive counterexample if not.
available: matched state and one known nonzero load

cases.query: All twelve phase-stepped powers fit a reciprocal three-load target model. Can this fit alone certify that the reference was stable between target states,or can a target-free background counterfeit exactly the same transcript?

Does changing a hidden-port receiver from intensity-only detection to coherent reference detection beat the old square-root error law under the same information contract,and does a linear error modulus prove better photon scaling?
unavailable: a matched photon or hardware advantage certificate

cases.query: A stationary reciprocal scattering matrix is calibrated and the receiver power is quiet. Can I now choose an arbitrary short detector window after reset,or must I acquire a settling envelope and rescale its block energy bound?
available: a conditional integrated field-error bound over a complete flush block
unavailable: a measured settling time from stationary scattering data
